scripts.use:dev: cp apps/backend/.env.dev apps/backend/.env && cp apps/landing/.env.dev apps/landing/.env && cp apps/app/.env.dev apps/app/.env && cp apps/admin/.env.dev apps/admin/.env && echo '✓ All apps switched to DEV environment'
scripts.use:prod: cp apps/backend/.env.prod apps/backend/.env && cp apps/landing/.env.prod apps/landing/.env && cp apps/app/.env.prod apps/app/.env && cp apps/admin/.env.prod apps/admin/.env && echo '✓ All apps switched to PROD environment'
scripts.dev:dev: pnpm use:dev && pnpm --filter backend --filter admin --filter landing --filter app dev
scripts.dev:dev:all: pnpm use:dev && pnpm --filter backend --filter admin --filter landing --filter app dev
scripts.dev:prod: pnpm use:prod && pnpm --filter backend --filter admin --filter landing --filter app dev
scripts.dev:prod:all: pnpm use:prod && pnpm --filter backend --filter admin --filter landing --filter app dev
